conditions: 6 AM—It's party time, people! You're cordially invited to come celebrate a "Sweet 16" by blasting back into the whiteroom behind a cold-smoke screen. High mountain powder turns sit atop a springtime cornucopia down low. Expect lingering pow showers this morning to be replaced by a mostly cloudy afternoon, but not before dropping another few inches on the flanks of Rendezvous Mountain. High temperatures will top out near 20 degrees on the deck of Corbet's Cabin and in the low 40s in Teton Village. Gusty northwest winds will be kicking your crystal roostertails skyward as they crank in the 10 to 30 mph range. Listen, I'm a mere powder forecaster, but it seems like missing out on April blower would result in sheer mental disaster. So, come follow the sound of your own maniacal laughter as you rip through the snow like a true big-mountain blaster. -Lege
